answer: A challenger who exposes a duplicate identity seizes the bond; false challenges burn the challenger's willow-thin reserve instead. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a ferrous-hard deposit in escrow before voting, and peers randomly challenge claimants to prove control of a unique hardware pearl fused to their key. Forging N identities therefore costs N deposits plus N pearls, making mass fakery economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0131's threat model.
